name: Vex
notes: Shadow Surge (R) opens the fight: the initial missile lands when its 0.25 s cast ends and marks the dummy (it counts as an enemy champion), and the mark is consumed by an immediate, cast-time-free recast for the larger bonus damage, matching the wiki's 'Recast: none' cast time and no stated travel delay.

R's cooldown starts post-effect of the initial cast (at the moment the initial missile lands), but at 100-140 s it is never ready again inside the fight, so only the opening cast-and-recast sequence is modeled.

Mistral Bolt (Q), Personal Space (W) and Looming Darkness (E) are cast on cooldown throughout the fight; each deals its damage at the moment of cast (Personal Space's own text says the scream and its damage happen before the cast time finishes) with the usual 0.25 s attack lockout for having a cast time.

Doom 'n Gloom (P) contributes nothing: Gloom only marks enemies that dash or blink, the stationary dummy never does either, so neither the detonation bonus damage nor Doom's cooldown refunds are ever reachable, per the dossier's resolution.
Looming Darkness's cooldown is taken as the wiki's and ddragon's flat 12 s at every rank, over the bin's conflicting flat 13 s.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here plausibly runs a level-16 Vex out of mana inside a 15 s fight.
Basic attacks fill every gap between casts since Vex is a ranged auto-attacker with no on-hit or attack-speed component in her kit.
